title: The Works: save the whole yard and put it back
lines: New tier 4 research, A plan of the whole yard: with Select in hand and nothing marked, Save yard keeps every piece in your yard in one of your blueprint places.
Put it back to swap between layouts: what already stands as the plan has it stays, with what it holds, and everything else is taken up or built for the difference in Coins.

more.head: How it works
points: The research needs the plan chest's shelves, and costs 15,000 Timber folios and 15,000 Brass folios.
A plan of the whole yard goes back where you saved it. It doesn't follow the pointer, and it can't be turned.
While you hold it, every piece it would take up is marked, and the line says how many pieces it builds and takes up. Place shows what it costs or gives back, and asks you to press it again.
If you're short of Coins, or a piece can't stand where the plan has it, nothing changes, and Place says why.
Undo takes the whole of it back.

more.head: Changed
points: Undo can take back a whole-yard placement, or clearing, in one step.
